# LightMD sample

A fixture used by the tests and for trying the viewer by hand:

```sh
npm start -- test/fixtures/sample.md
```

## Formatting

Some **bold**, some _italic_, some `inline code`, and a [link](https://example.com).

> A blockquote, for good measure.
